summary: The root يدي (ydy) primarily refers to the hand, signifying power, possession, or a gift. It can also denote a side, direction, or a means by which something is accomplished.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
